::: {.block title="Data"}
Chl *a* profiles from BGC-Argo floats, OOI moorings and gliders (@fig-data; March 2024 – October 2026), estimated from in situ fluorescence, were averaged into 10 m bins to 200 m. The satellite data were remote-sensing reflectance (R~rs~): PACE OCI L3 daily 4 km (172 bands) and Sentinel-3 Ocean and Land Colour Instrument (OLCI) L3 daily (11 bands). After quality control, 9,542 BGC-Argo profiles (831 floats), 20,971 OOI 3 h windows (30 instruments, 5 locations) and 2,289 glider windows had PACE matchups.
:::
